summary: CVC-PE Global Private Equity Fund, LP filed an 8-K reporting the sale of unregistered limited partnership units under its continuous private offering, raising aggregate consideration of approximately $60.2 million on July 1, 2026. The sale consisted of Class R-S, R-I, C, and G units priced at the June 30, 2026 transactional NAV per class, with values ranging from $115.33 to $118.56. Units were sold under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D exemptions. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation, with no change in control, premium, or strategic event. The filing also discloses transactional NAV for investor pricing.
